item.title: Report: US-Iran talks deadlocked as Qatar mediation efforts stall
item.description: Qatar’s efforts to bridge differences between the US and Iran have stalled, with both sides holding firm as concerns grow over renewed military conflict, according to Axios.

item.title: Watch: Wounded in Jabaliya, IDF soldier dances with Smotrich at Simchat Beit Hashoeva
item.description: Moving: IDF soldier Yotam Asban, critically wounded fighting in Jabaliya, joins Simchat Beit Hashoeva celebration at Mercaz HaRav and dances with Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich.

item.title: US State Department: We condemn violence in Judea and Samaria
item.description: A US State Department spokesperson commented on the violence against Palestinian Arabs in Judea and Samaria overnight in an interview with i24NEWS, saying: “We condemn criminal violence by any party in the West Bank and support appropriate investigations, prosecutions, and legal action against those responsible."

item.title: Likud attacks Lapid: His statement was prepared in advance, unrelated to the meeting
item.description:
The Likud party criticized opposition leader Yair Lapid after the Prime Minister’s Office issued a statement following his meeting with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The party claimed that Lapid issued a political statement attacking Netanyahu just minutes after the meeting ended.
“He left the meeting with Prime Minister Netanyahu at 11:39 p.m. At 11:41 p.m., just two minutes later, at record speed, he issued a lengthy statement that was entirely a political attack on the Prime Minister," Likud said. “Either he writes at the speed of light, or the statement was prepared in advance and had nothing to do with the briefing he received. So much for the late-night Lapid."

item.title: PMO: Lapid was briefed on warnings of possible attacks ahead of the elections
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu concluded a security briefing with opposition leader Yair Lapid, attended by the Prime Minister’s military secretary and the Military Secretariat’s intelligence officer.
The Prime Minister’s Office said the intelligence briefing included detailed warnings of possible attacks on various fronts ahead of the elections.

item.title: 13-year-old from Qalandiya arrested on suspicion of arson near Kokhav Yaakov
item.description:
Police launched an investigation into suspected arson in an open area near the community of Kokhav Yaakov. IDF soldiers from the Binyamin Brigade who were called to the scene arrested a suspect in connection with the incident.
The suspect, a 13-year-old resident of Qalandiya, was taken for questioning at the Binyamin police station. The investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Stop asking why they hate us. Love being a Jew.
item.description: The blessing of being Jewish in this world is to live every stage of life with dignity, meaning, and purpose. Op-ed.

item.title: Lapid after security briefing with Netanyahu: No reason to cause public panic
item.description:
Opposition leader Yair Lapid commented on the security briefing he received from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying he would not violate the confidentiality of the briefing, but argued that “Israel’s security and IDF bases are not the backdrop for campaign videos."
According to Lapid, the IDF, Shin Bet and police are prepared for the elections and “there is no reason to cause public panic." He added that he demanded Netanyahu hold a meeting with the Shin Bet chief and Central Elections Committee Chairman Justice Noam Solberg ahead of the election.

item.description: The strength required to build our home, that is, our national homeland, must be spiritual might, the might of the festival, the might of God’s eternal word.

item.description: President Trump says Iran is struggling and will eventually “give up," while insisting Tehran cannot be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

item.title: Mother of terror attack victim Neria Leiter: 'A time of uncertainty'
item.description: Nearly a week after Neria Leiter was critically wounded in a terror attack on Route 443, his mother, Hani, speaks about the uncertainty in the ICU, hopes for his recovery, and the family that has remained by his side around the clock.

item.title: Hamas’ enemy turns partner: Dahlan-Hamas rapprochement signals battle for post-Abbas era
item.description: For years, Mohammed Dahlan was one of Hamas’s fiercest enemies and a senior figure in the Palestinian security services that fought the organization. Now, a dramatic rapprochement causes worry on the battle over who will succeed Mahmoud Abbas.

item.title: Innocent? Death row inmate released from prison after 41 years
item.description: A man who spent 41 years on death row in the US after being convicted of killing a woman has been released on bail after prosecutors said a new analysis of DNA evidence did not link him to the crime.

item.title: Reporters came to cover an accident, witnessed another accident
